name: Windows
shortDescription: Reach homeowners replacing drafty, failing or outdated windows and connect them with window companies for in-home consultations.
description: Window replacement is a high-ticket home improvement purchase driven by comfort, energy costs, noise and appearance. Homeowners begin shopping when they notice drafts, condensation between panes, difficulty opening or locking sashes, rising heating and cooling bills, or when they want to update the look of an older home. Many projects involve replacing most or all of a home's windows at once, which makes each qualified appointment valuable and makes financing a frequent part of the conversation.

Altarious Global reaches homeowners during their research with performance marketing focused on window replacement and delivers them to window manufacturers, dealers and installers through Inbound Calls and Live Transfers. Screening confirms homeownership, the number of windows, the reasons for replacement, timeline and decision-maker availability so that consultants meet with homeowners ready to make a whole-home decision.
consumerProfile: Owners of single-family homes built more than fifteen to twenty years ago with original or failing windows, typically aged 40 to 70 with equity or financing capacity. The most valuable segments are homeowners replacing five or more windows, those motivated by energy efficiency and comfort, and owners of older homes seeking a full exterior update alongside doors or siding.
intentSignals: Searching for window replacement cost or window companies near me
Drafts, condensation between panes or fogged glass observed
Windows difficult to open, close or lock, or showing rot around frames
Heating and cooling bills rising noticeably
Preparing a home for sale or recently purchased an older home
Researching energy-efficient windows and available rebates
qualificationCriteria: Owns a single-family home within the company's service area
Number of windows to be replaced meets the company's minimum
Reason for replacement and any specific window types identified
Project timeline stated, typically within the next several months
Homeowner and co-decision maker available for an in-home consultation
Openness to financing or a stated budget for the project
keywords: how much to replace all windows in a house
marketContext: Replacement windows are one of the largest categories in the home improvement industry, dominated by national manufacturers with dealer networks and by regional installers competing on price, product quality and consultation experience. The sales model relies on in-home consultations, so companies invest heavily in appointment generation and are highly sensitive to appointment quality and show rates. Energy efficiency standards and utility rebates support demand, while homeowners increasingly research online before agreeing to a visit. Companies that secure exclusive, well-qualified consultations with both decision makers present achieve materially better closing economics.
inboundCallsAngle: Homeowners considering a window project usually want to understand pricing ranges, materials and timelines before committing to a consultation, and a phone call is the fastest way to get those answers. Inbound Call programs place window replacement offers in front of homeowners researching the category and invite them to call the company directly. Callers arrive with a project in mind and often know roughly how many windows they need, allowing appointment setters to qualify the opportunity, address objections and schedule an in-home consultation within a single conversation.
liveTransfersAngle: Live Transfers provide window companies with consultation-ready homeowners. Our team confirms homeownership, property location, number of windows, reasons for replacement, timeline and whether all decision makers can attend before warm-transferring to the company's scheduling team. This pre-screen removes renters, single-window repairs below the company's minimum and homeowners who are only gathering general pricing, so consultants spend their time on whole-home projects with a realistic path to a signed agreement. Transfer volume can be tuned to the number of consultations the sales team can run each week.

faq.q: Can you enforce a minimum number of windows?
faq.a: Yes. Screening captures the number of windows the homeowner plans to replace, and a minimum threshold can be set to match your project requirements.

faq.q: Do you confirm that both homeowners can attend the consultation?
faq.a: Decision-maker availability is part of the standard screening, which supports in-home sales models that require all owners to be present.

faq.q: Can programs include doors or siding alongside windows?
faq.a: Campaigns can be expanded to cover entry doors, patio doors and siding if you offer them, and screening can identify homeowners interested in multiple exterior products.
